items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And Brother Reed... They had places all over, back off those back roads and everywhere back out in those woods, like all kinds of places running all night.

ctx.x: Yeah, Stamps Brothers in East Jackson; Stamps Brothers Hotel. And Brother Reed... They had places all over, back off those back roads and everywhere back out in those woods, like all kinds of places running all night.
